On October 2, 2026, Chad J. Swanson, Ph.D., Chief Development Officer of Prothena Corporation plc (the “Company”) notified the Company that he is resigning from the Company effective October 9, 2026. Dr. Swanson is resigning to accept a position with one of the Company’s strategic partners, and, as part of his new role, will assume a leadership role over a program partnered with the Company.
